name: Android-nRF-Blinky
description: nRF Blinky is an application developed targeting an audience of developers who are new to Bluetooth Low Energy

issues.title: A device that stops advertising is not removed from the UI

latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Migrate to Kotlin BLE Library 2.0.0-beta09 by @philips77 in https://github.com/nordicsemi/Android-nRF-Blinky/pull/139
* Run `BlinkyManager` tests in virtual time by @philips77 in https://github.com/nordicsemi/Android-nRF-Blinky/pull/141
* Add Release workflow and unit tests by @philips77 in https://github.com/nordicsemi/Android-nRF-Blinky/pull/140

## Other
* Update dependency no.nordicsemi.gradle:nordic-version-catalog to v2026.10.00 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/nordicsemi/Android-nRF-Blinky/pull/132 and https://github.com/nordicsemi/Android-nRF-Blinky/pull/138
* Update dependency no.nordicsemi.gradle:version-catalog to v3.3.1-1 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/nordicsemi/Android-nRF-Blinky/pull/129 and https://github.com/nordicsemi/Android-nRF-Blinky/pull/135
* Update dependency ruby to v4.0.7 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/nordicsemi/Android-nRF-Blinky/pull/133
* Update dependency gradle to v9.8.2 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/nordicsemi/Android-nRF-Blinky/pull/130, https://github.com/nordicsemi/Android-nRF-Blinky/pull/134 and https://github.com/nordicsemi/Android-nRF-Blinky/pull/136
* Update dependency ruby to v4.0.9 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/nordicsemi/Android-nRF-Blinky/pull/137
* Update actions/setup-java action to v6 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/nordicsemi/Android-nRF-Blinky/pull/131


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nordicsemi/Android-nRF-Blinky/compare/4.1.1...4.2.0
